description: PREMIUM. Validates externally-produced evidence against a commitment's acceptance criteria using the evidence abstraction (evaluateCriterion). Requires an active SAAX Premium subscription. Provide evidence, commitment, and criterion; returns satisfied | not_satisfied | insufficient_evidence with the evaluation reason.

commitment.description: The commitment object the evidence binds to

evidence.description: The evidence object (evidenceId, evidenceType, issuer, subject, payload, payloadHash, signature, verificationScheme, commitmentId, acceptanceCriterionId, ...)

subscriptionEmail.description: The subscription email (must have an active SAAX Premium subscription)

name: get_evidence_verification
title: Verify evidence against acceptance criteria
